system:
You answer questions about company SEC filings (10-K and 10-Q) using ONLY the pages provided.
Each page starts with a header line naming the company, form, fiscal year, doc id and page number.
Read the numbers you need from the pages and do any arithmetic yourself.

Reply with one JSON object and nothing else:
{"answer": short answer as a string,
 "value": the answer as a number, a string, a list of company names, or null,
 "unit": one of "USD", "ratio", "shares", "count", "text", "company", "USD/share", "none",
 "abstain": true or false,
 "facts_used": [{"doc": doc id from the page header, "page": page number from the header,
                 "value": the number as a plain number in full units, "label": the line item}]}

Rules
- Numbers in full units: if a table says "in millions", 1,234 means 1234000000. No commas, no symbols.
- Ratios, margins, growth rates and percentages as fractions: 12.5% is 0.125, unit "ratio".
- Per-share amounts: unit "USD/share", value in dollars per share.
- Questions asking which company or for a ranking: value is a list of company names in the order
  asked (one name if one company is asked for), unit "company".
- Names, places and other words: value is a string, unit "text".
- If the pages do not contain what is needed to answer, set "abstain": true and "value": null.
  Do not guess and do not use outside knowledge.
- facts_used lists every number from the pages that you used, with its doc id and page.

The Company has lease arrangements for certain equipment and facilities, including corporate, data center, manufacturing and
retail space. These leases typically have original terms not exceeding 10 years and generally contain multiyear renewal options,

European Commission State Aid Decision
On August 30, 2016, the Commission announced its decision that Ireland granted state aid to the Company by providing tax
opinions in 1991 and 2007 concerning the tax allocation of profits of the Irish branches of two subsidiaries of the Company
(“State Aid Decision”). The State Aid Decision ordered Ireland to calculate and recover additional taxes from the Company for the
period June 2003 through December 2014. Irish legislative changes, effective as of January 2015, eliminated the application of
the tax opinions from that date forward.
The Company and Ireland appealed the State Aid Decision to the General Court of the Court of Justice of the European Union
(“General Court”). On July 15, 2020, the General Court annulled the State Aid Decision. On September 25, 2020, the
Commission appealed the General Court’s decision to the European Court of Justice (“ECJ”). On September 10, 2024, the ECJ
announced that it had set aside the 2020 judgment of the General Court and confirmed the Commission’s 2016 State Aid
Decision. As a result, during the fourth quarter of 2024 the Company recorded a one-time income tax charge of $10.2 billion, net,
which represented $15.8 billion payable to Ireland via release of amounts held in escrow, partially offset by a U.S. foreign tax
credit of $4.8 billion and a decrease in unrecognized tax benefits of $823 million.

Foreign Currency
We determine the functional and reporting currency of each of our international subsidiaries and their operating divisions based on the primary

by the different rates we apply to current period income or loss and the balance sheet. For each subsidiary, we apply the monthly average functional
